def pcells(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); out=[]
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            if a[r][c]=='p': out.append((r,c))
    return out
def psummary(pc):
    if not pc: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in pc]; cs=[c for r,c in pc]
    return ("rows",min(rs),max(rs),"cols",min(cs),max(cs),"n",len(pc))
print("flood now", psummary(pcells(current_frame)))

def ypos(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
print("Y now", ypos(current_frame))
# crop around player after click
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
for r in range(36,42):
